scripts: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_DATA_TABLE (modeId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modeName TEXT, iconId TEXT, iconColor TEXT, filletIcon TEXT, roundIcon TEXT, isSupportDelete INTEGER, modePriority INTEGER, updateTime INTEGER, createTime INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_CONFIG_DATA_TABLE (configId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modeId TEXT, configType INTEGER, configValue TEXT, updateTime INTEGER, createTime INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CONTACT_DATA (contactId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, modeId TEXT, detail_info TEXT, format_phone_number TEXT, focus_mode_list TEXT, updateTime INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_HISTORY_DATA_TABLE (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, operType TEXT, ruleName TEXT, modeId TEXT, priority INTEGER, timestamp INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS LEARNING_PLAN (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, planName TEXT, status INTEGER DEFAULT 0, createTime INTEGER, updateTime INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MODE_OPERATION_DATA (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, modeId TEXT, operationTime TEXT, longitude TEXT, latitude TEXT, locationDesc TEXT, application TEXT, week TEXT, duration INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS RULE_FEEDBACK (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, ruleId TEXT, modeId TEXT, createTime INTEGER, timeRange TEXT, longitude TEXT, latitude TEXT, application TEXT, feedback TEXT);
ALTER TABLE MODE_HISTORY_DATA_TABLE ADD COLUMN configId TEXT;
UPDATE MODE_HISTORY_DATA_TABLE SET configId = SUBSTRING(ruleName, 6) WHERE ruleName LIKE 'rule\_%' ESCAPE '\';
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS CURSOR_DATA_TABLE (tableName TEXT PRIMARY KEY, currentCursor INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS FORM_INFO_TABLE (formId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, formName TEXT, formDimension TEXT);
